package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const (
	PlannerVersion           = "course-planner-v1"
	CourseFingerprintVersion = "course-fingerprint-v1"
	DefaultPedagogyProfile   = "standard-v1"
	DefaultPresentationStyle = "standard-v1"
	DefaultGenerationPolicy  = "shared-v1"
	DefaultMasteryConfidence = 0.80
)

type PolicyBundle struct {
	PlannerVersion         string                    `json:"planner_version"`
	PedagogyProfile        string                    `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	PresentationStyle      string                    `json:"presentation_style"`
	GenerationPolicy       string                    `json:"generation_policy"`
	MasterySkipConfidence  float64                   `json:"mastery_skip_confidence"`
	LessonPersonalization  bool                      `json:"lesson_personalization"`
	ExamplePersonalization bool                      `json:"example_personalization"`
	TaskPersonalization    bool                      `json:"task_personalization"`
	TestPersonalization    bool                      `json:"test_personalization"`
	PedagogyStrategies     []PedagogyStrategyVersion `json:"pedagogy_strategies"`
}

type PedagogyStrategyVersion struct {
	Code     string          `json:"code"`
	Version  int             `json:"version"`
	Priority int             `json:"priority"`
	Config   json.RawMessage `json:"config"`
}

type PedagogyStrategyRef struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Version int    `json:"version"`
}

func NormalizePolicyBundle(input PolicyBundle) (PolicyBundle, error) {
	input.PlannerVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerVersion)
	input.PedagogyProfile = normalizeCode(input.PedagogyProfile)
	input.PresentationStyle = normalizeCode(input.PresentationStyle)
	input.GenerationPolicy = normalizeCode(input.GenerationPolicy)
	if input.PlannerVersion == "" || input.PedagogyProfile == "" || input.PresentationStyle == "" ||
		input.GenerationPolicy == "" || input.MasterySkipConfidence < 0 || input.MasterySkipConfidence > 1 ||
		len(input.PedagogyStrategies) == 0 {
		return PolicyBundle{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.PedagogyStrategies))
	for index := range input.PedagogyStrategies {
		strategy := &input.PedagogyStrategies[index]
		strategy.Code = normalizeCode(strategy.Code)
		strategy.Config = bytes.TrimSpace(strategy.Config)
		var config map[string]any
		if strategy.Code == "" || strategy.Version < 1 || len(strategy.Config) == 0 ||
			json.Unmarshal(strategy.Config, &config) != nil || config == nil {
			return PolicyBundle{}, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := strategy.Code + ":" + strconv.Itoa(strategy.Version)
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return PolicyBundle{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	sort.Slice(input.PedagogyStrategies, func(left, right int) bool {
		if input.PedagogyStrategies[left].Priority != input.PedagogyStrategies[right].Priority {
			return input.PedagogyStrategies[left].Priority > input.PedagogyStrategies[right].Priority
		}
		if input.PedagogyStrategies[left].Code != input.PedagogyStrategies[right].Code {
			return input.PedagogyStrategies[left].Code < input.PedagogyStrategies[right].Code
		}
		return input.PedagogyStrategies[left].Version < input.PedagogyStrategies[right].Version
	})
	return input, nil
}
